purpose: Teach: 三宮/松平/トゥ/吉井/岩本/半田/栗山/入江

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、神戸三宮駅周辺の事案を、警察、対応されますね
lines.en: So regarding this case in the Kobe Sannomiya area — the police are handling the investigation, aren't they?
lines.style: Careful, somewhat formal phrasing. Slight upward lift at the end — seeking confirmation rather than stating fact. Measured tempo, precise articulation. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、徳川松平家ゆかりの古文書盗難も捜査されますね
lines.en: Yes, and the police are also investigating the theft of those historical documents related to the Tokugawa and Matsudaira families.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Steady, informative tone. Small nod of understanding in the delivery. Collaborative rather than defensive. Maintains official clarity while remaining approachable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、英語通訳でトゥ、つまり「to」発音を、警察、正確にされますね
lines.en: So in terms of the English interpreter — handling that 'tu' sound, the 'to' pronunciation — the police are being precise about that, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before clarifying the detail in parentheses. Slight pedagogical tone — explaining for shared understanding, not lecturing. Curious rather than challenging. Deliberate articulation on the technical term.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、参考人吉井氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: Right. The police will be interviewing the witness Yoshii as well to gather their account of what happened.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Matter-of-fact tone without coldness. The words of someone going through necessary steps. Slight emphasis on 'will be' — reassurance that it's already planned. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者岩本氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And the police are also being considerate of the victim Iwamoto's family situation in how they're handling this, aren't they?
lines.style: Softer inflection on the word 'family'. A gentle checking-in rather than interrogating. Quiet concern threaded through the formal phrasing. Respectful acknowledgment of human impact beneath the procedural language.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の半田、つまり半田痕の鑑識もされますね
lines.en: Exactly. The forensic examination of what we found at the scene — the solder marks, that is — is being conducted as well.
lines.style: Technical shift in tone. Slight slow-down to clarify the technical term in parentheses. Precise, methodical. The confidence of someone who knows exactly what was collected and why. Professional and complete.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者栗山の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: Regarding the suspect Kuriyama — the police are verifying their prior record, I assume?
lines.style: Measured and formal. Small upward lilt on 'I assume' — confirmation-seeking rather than assuming. Methodical pacing. The tone of someone working through a mental checklist with a collaborator.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の入江、つまり入江地形の捜索もされますね
lines.en: Yes. The search of the inlet area at the scene — the geography of that cove — is being carried out as we speak.
lines.style: Firm, assured closing. Slight emphasis on 'as we speak' — conveying active, ongoing work. Clear and conclusive without abruptness. The tone of someone confirming that all necessary pieces are in motion.
